text: 【银河证券完成第一批A股买入操作 互换便利增量资金入市提速】记者了解到，截至11月6日，银河证券已执行第三批互换便利操作，成功办理第一笔回购融资，并完成第一批投资买入操作。银河证券表示，自2024年互换便利工具创设以来，公司便积极响应政策要求，高效推进互换便利相关工作，充分运用央行货币政策工具支持股票市场稳定发展，后续也将用足用好融入资金，持续开展权益市场的长期资产配置。今年11月3日，为支持资本市场健康稳定发展，央行开展机构进行第三批互换便利操作，整体意向申报额度超过1000亿元，31家券商、基金公司最终参与并中标，启动买入操作。市场普遍认为，在外部环境复杂多变、市场波动加大的背景下，机构踊跃参与互换便利，表明专业投资者对市场长期前景有信心，有助于推动增量资金入市、修复市场风险偏好。
text_en: [Galaxy Securities completes first batch of A-share purchases; incremental funds from the swap facility enter the market faster] The reporter learned that as of November 6, Galaxy Securities had executed the third batch of swap facility operations, successfully completed its first repo financing, and completed the first batch of investment purchases. Galaxy Securities said that since the swap facility tool was created in 2024, the company has actively responded to policy requirements, efficiently advanced work related to the swap facility, and fully used the PBOC's monetary policy tools to support the stable development of the stock market; it will continue to make full and good use of the funds raised and continue long-term asset allocation in the equity market. On November 3 this year, to support the healthy and stable development of the capital market, the PBOC launched the third batch of swap facility operations for institutions, with total intended declared quotas exceeding 100 billion yuan; 31 securities firms and fund companies ultimately participated and won bids, starting purchase operations. The market generally believes that amid a complex and volatile external environment and increased market volatility, institutions' enthusiastic participation in the swap facility shows professional investors' confidence in the market's long-term prospects and helps drive incremental funds into the market and repair market risk appetite.
